parameters.second: The panes, start then end (or top then bottom).
parameters.minSecond: The minimum extent of the second pane.
parameters.onChanged: Reports where the bar moved to.
parameters.label: The bar's name for a screen reader.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Whether the bar takes the focus when it first appears and nothing else has it.
parameters.first: The pane on the reading-start side.
parameters.minFirst: The minimum extent of the first pane.
